headline: The care platform you actually own
subhead: A generic neutral core with opt-in Health, Education, and ERP overlays. Ship small, ship independently, compose per tenant, run it on your own infrastructure.
positioning: Self-hosted first. Event-led. Multi-tenant from one codebase. No managed-cloud lock-in.
description: CuraOS is a composable, self-hosted-first platform: a generic neutral core with opt-in vertical overlays (Health, Education, ERP). Deploy on cloud, on-prem, hybrid, or fully air-gapped.
valueProps: Self-hosted first: deployable on customer infrastructure, no managed-cloud lock-in.
Generic before vertical: a reusable neutral core that verticals extend, never fork.
Event-led: durable messaging with versioned contracts; sync APIs are secondary.
Multi-tenant: SaaS, on-prem, and hybrid from one codebase, with tenant data isolation.
Builder-led: every experience expressed through the workflow engine and app/site builder.

pillars.title: Self-hosted first
pillars.blurb: Deploy on your own infrastructure. Hybrid and fully air-gapped are first-class, not afterthoughts. No managed-cloud lock-in.

pillars.title: Generic before vertical
pillars.blurb: One reusable neutral core. Verticals extend it through documented seams; they never fork it.

pillars.title: Event-led
pillars.blurb: Durable, versioned event contracts are the primary integration path. Sync APIs are secondary.

pillars.title: Multi-tenant
pillars.blurb: SaaS, on-prem, and hybrid from one codebase, with strict tenant data isolation and a PHI boundary.

pillars.title: Builder-led
pillars.blurb: Every surface is generated from workflow definitions and the app/site builder. Configure, do not hand-code.

pillars.title: Composable
pillars.blurb: Services, libraries, and clients ship independently and combine per tenant and per market.

architecture.caption: Vertical overlays depend on the neutral core. The dependency direction is always toward the core, never the reverse.

deployProfiles.name: On-prem
deployProfiles.blurb: Single tenant on customer infrastructure; overlays opt-in.

deployProfiles.name: Hybrid
deployProfiles.blurb: Vendor control plane plus a customer-hosted data plane.

deployProfiles.name: Home lab / air-gap
deployProfiles.blurb: Single tenant, fully offline, same artifacts, zero external calls.

quickstart.caption: Compose a tenant from the neutral core plus the overlays you need.
lines: ok: acme up on your infrastructure, zero external calls

footer.note: CuraOS is a self-hosted-first, composable care platform.
